title: CIT-Lasso: a scalable approach beyond guilty by association for identifying causal variants from genome-wide summary statistics.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 20944947 via its API: one file, CITLasso-v0.3.0.zip (8.4 MB), CC-BY-4.0, described as the software release, i.e. code and not a dataset. The NIAGADS page for NG00075 (Kunkle Alzheimer's summary statistics) says full files require a data access application through the DARM portal; only p-value-only files are open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the analysis reuses public GWAS (genome-wide association study) summary statistics from NIAGADS, GWAS Catalog (GCST90027158, GCST90012877) and 67 other studies, and that it reports 82 Alzheimer's loci. The supplement listing timed out and was not retrieved.

a1_downloadable.note: The paper deposits only code (checked on Zenodo). Most Alzheimer's inputs sit at NIAGADS, where full summary statistics need an access application (checked NG00075 page); controlled access.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No measured label exists. 'Causal variant' calls are outputs of CIT-Lasso; a training label would have to be built from MPRA (massively parallel reporter assay) or CRISPR studies elsewhere.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are third-party summary statistics referenced by accession, not deposited with the paper.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: no labelled table was deposited.

a5_enough_rows.note: No labelled table; 82 Alzheimer's loci is far too few to train on even if they were labels.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Genome-wide summary statistics are a few GB per trait (not checked)
a6_fits_laptop.note: The method itself is claimed to run on one CPU in 15 minutes.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Nothing to count; no data file deposited.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any 'causal' label from this paper is a statistical method's output, so a model trained on it would just copy CIT-Lasso.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: this is a statistical-methods paper whose only deposit is software, so no labelled dataset exists to make a claim about.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use DNA sequence around genetic variants to predict which variants this method flags as likely causes of Alzheimer's disease.
plain_idea.train_on: Variants at disease-associated regions with their sequence context; number of examples unknown, since no variant-level table was deposited.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a variant is prioritised as causal, but that answer is the CIT-Lasso method's own output, not a lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It would let researchers rank variants without summary statistics, but copying another algorithm's calls teaches nothing new about biology.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper alone; a variant-effect project would need measured MPRA or CRISPR screen data from other sources instead.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the Zenodo record: it holds only an 8.4 MB code zip (done).

verdict_reason: A statistical-methods paper that deposits only code. It has no measured label: the causal calls are the method's own output. Its main Alzheimer's inputs sit at NIAGADS behind an access application.
